unit.intent: Make the BULK INSERT paths in proc_load_bronze.sql resolve inside the SQL Server container: correct directory and correct filename case.

baseline.notes: Same repo state as recon-adoption (see .forge/ledger-recon-adoption.json). Suite not runnable yet: no sqlcmd, no MSSQL service; Docker Desktop starting to host a SQL Server container. Datasets on disk: source_crm/*.csv lowercase, source_erp/*.csv UPPERCASE (CUST_AZ12.csv, LOC_A101.csv, PX_CAT_G1V2.csv).

transitions.evidence: Runtime-verified: bronze.load_bronze executed in SQL Server 2022 container, all 6 tables loaded (crm_cust_info 18493, crm_prd_info 397, crm_sales_details 60398, erp_loc_a101 18484, erp_cust_az12 18483, erp_px_cat_g1v2 37). ERP loads succeeded with case-corrected paths, proving the case fix matters on Linux. Full pipeline then ran green: silver load, gold views, silver checks (all automated checks 0 rows), gold checks (0 rows).
transitions.ruling: Paths fixed to the container mount /var/opt/mssql/datasets (recorded in overlays.yaml) and filename case corrected to match disk (LOC_A101.csv, CUST_AZ12.csv, PX_CAT_G1V2.csv). Cost if wrong: paths are container-specific; a non-container SQL Server run needs a new unit. Also ruled: scripts assume the session is already in DataWarehouse (only init_database.sql carries USE) — container runs pass -d DataWarehouse; recorded in overlay, not a code change.
